rewind.noticeConversationOnlySaveFailed: Rewound conversation, but failed to save state: {error}

vaultSearch.toolDescription: Search vault notes for this turn

general.suspiciousPlan: Bring me a note and a mildly suspicious plan.

quips.spell: Today's spell: fewer tabs, better answers.
quips.cleanDiff: A clean diff is a kind of magic.
quips.noPressure: No pressure, just a vault full of context.
quips.earnKeep: Let us make this note earn its keep.

userName.name: What should Grimoire call you?
userName.desc: Your name for personalized greetings (leave empty for generic greetings)

excludedTags.name: Excluded tags
excludedTags.desc: Notes with these tags will not auto-load as context (one per line, without #)

excludedFolders.name: Excluded folders
excludedFolders.desc: Notes in these vault folders are excluded from agent access unless explicitly included with @ (one vault-relative path per line)

mediaFolder.name: Media folder
mediaFolder.desc: Folder containing attachments/images. When notes use ![[image.jpg]], Claude will look here. Leave empty for vault root.

systemPrompt.name: Custom system prompt
systemPrompt.desc: Additional instructions appended to the default system prompt

autoTitle.name: Auto-generate conversation titles
autoTitle.desc: Automatically generate conversation titles after the first user message is sent.

titleModel.name: Title generation model
titleModel.desc: Model used for auto-generating conversation titles.

navMappings.name: Vim-style navigation mappings
navMappings.desc: One mapping per line. Format: "map <key> <action>" (actions: scrollUp, scrollDown, focusInput).

requireCommandOrControlEnterToSend.name: Send only with button
requireCommandOrControlEnterToSend.desc: When enabled, Enter and Command/Ctrl+Enter insert line breaks instead of sending. Use the Send button to submit.

usageIndicators.name: Usage indicators
usageIndicators.desc: Show plan usage and API spend indicators beside the model selector and inside the model menu.

debugLogging.name: Debug logging
debugLogging.desc: Write sanitized technical logs to .grimoire/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl only while enabled. Prompts, answers, note contents, paths, environment values, and secrets are redacted.

slashCommands.name: Commands and Skills
slashCommands.desc: Manage vault-level commands and skills stored in .claude/commands/ and .claude/skills/. Triggered by /name.

hiddenSlashCommands.name: Hidden Commands and Skills
hiddenSlashCommands.desc: Hide specific commands and skills from the dropdown. Useful for hiding Claude Code entries that are not relevant to Grimoire. Enter names without the leading slash, one per line.

mcpServers.name: MCP Servers
mcpServers.desc: Manage vault-level MCP server configurations stored in .claude/mcp.json. Servers with context-saving mode require @mention to activate.

subagents.name: Subagents
subagents.desc: Manage vault-level subagents stored in .claude/agents/. Each Markdown file defines one custom agent.
subagents.noAgents: No subagents configured. Click + to create one.
subagents.renameCleanupFailed: Warning: could not remove old file for "{name}"

modal.name: Name
modal.nameDesc: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Reviews code for bugs and style
modal.toolsDesc: Comma-separated list of allowed tools (empty = all)
modal.disallowedToolsDesc: Comma-separated list of tools to disallow
modal.promptPlaceholder: You are a code reviewer. Analyze the given code for...

customVariables.name: Custom variables
customVariables.desc: Environment variables for Claude SDK (KEY=VALUE format, one per line). Shell export prefix supported.

envSnippets.name: Snippets
envSnippets.noSnippets: No saved environment snippets yet. Click + to save your current environment configuration.
envSnippets.nameRequired: Please enter a name for the snippet

modal.name: Name
modal.namePlaceholder: A descriptive name for this environment configuration
modal.envVarsPlaceholder: KEY=VALUE format, one per line (export prefix supported)

customModelOverrides.name: Custom model overrides
customModelOverrides.desc: Set model selector aliases and context window sizes for custom models.

customContextLimits.name: Custom Context Limits
customContextLimits.desc: Set context window sizes for your custom models. Leave empty to use the default (200k tokens).
customContextLimits.invalid: Invalid format. Use: 256k, 1m, or exact count (1000-10000000).

enableOpus1M.name: Opus 1M context window
enableOpus1M.desc: Show Opus 1M in the model selector. Included with Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

enableSonnet1M.name: Sonnet 1M context window
enableSonnet1M.desc: Show Sonnet 1M in the model selector. Requires extra usage on Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

customModels.name: Custom models
customModels.desc: Append additional Claude model IDs to the picker, one per line. Environment model overrides still replace the picker.

respectProjectSettings.name: Respect Claude Code settings
respectProjectSettings.desc: Use model and env from Claude Code user and project settings. This enables custom models from providers such as MiniMax, Z.ai, and other Anthropic-compatible gateways. Grimoire settings still override explicit choices.

enableChrome.name: Enable Chrome extension
enableChrome.desc: Allow Claude to interact with Chrome via the claude-in-chrome extension. Requires the extension to be installed. Requires session restart.

enableBangBash.name: Enable bash mode (!)
enableBangBash.desc: Type ! on empty input to enter bash mode. Runs commands directly via Node.js child_process. Requires view reopen.

validation.noNode: Node.js not found on PATH. Install Node.js or check your PATH configuration.

maxTabs.name: Maximum chat tabs
maxTabs.desc: Maximum number of concurrent chat tabs (1-10).
maxTabs.warning: Higher tab counts may affect performance and memory usage.

tabBarPosition.name: Tab bar position
tabBarPosition.desc: Choose where to display tab badges and action buttons

enableAutoScroll.name: Auto-scroll during streaming
enableAutoScroll.desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom as Claude streams responses. Disable to stay at the top and read from the beginning.

deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.name: Defer math rendering during streaming
deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.desc: Show raw LaTeX while responses stream, then render math once when each text block completes.

chatViewPlacement.name: Open Grimoire in
chatViewPlacement.desc: Choose where the chat panel opens when it is created

cliPath.name: Claude CLI path
cliPath.desc: Custom path to Claude Code CLI. Leave empty for auto-detection.
cliPath.descWindows: For the native installer, use claude.exe. For npm/pnpm/yarn or other package manager installs, use the cli-wrapper.cjs path (not claude.cmd).
cliPath.descUnix: Paste the output of "which claude" — works for both native and npm/pnpm/yarn installs.

validation.isDirectory: Path is a directory, not a file

language.name: Language
language.desc: Change the display language of the plugin interface

contextEngine.name: Context engine
contextEngine.desc: Configure vault search and relevant note context.

projectWorkspaces.name: Project workspaces
projectWorkspaces.desc: Save scoped instructions and context sources for recurring work.

grok.desc: xAI's agentic coding CLI with plan mode, subagents, skills, and MCP.

cliPath.desc: Optional absolute path to the Grok Build CLI for this computer. Leave empty to use `grok` from PATH.

visibleModels.name: Visible models
visibleModels.desc: Choose which Grok Build models appear in the chat selector. Filter by provider or type to search. The current session model stays pinned even if it is not selected here.

modelPicker.searchPlaceholder: Filter by model, provider, or ID...
modelPicker.notReported: Not currently reported by Grok Build
modelPicker.aliasTitle: Custom label shown in the model selector. Leave empty to use the default.
modelPicker.loadFailed: Could not load the Grok Build model catalog. Check the CLI path and login state, then expand this section again.
modelPicker.startToLoad: Start Grok Build once to load its model catalog. Grimoire will then let you pick visible models.
modelPicker.unavailableTitle: Configured model not currently reported by Grok Build

advanced.summary: Hidden commands, subagents, environment, and context overrides

commands.desc: Grok Build can auto-detect vault-level Claude slash commands from .claude/commands/ and skills from .claude/skills/, .codex/skills/, and .agents/skills/. Manage those entries in the Claude or Codex settings tab. This setting only hides entries from the Grok Build dropdown.

hiddenCommands.desc: Hide specific Grok Build commands and skills from the dropdown. Enter names without the leading slash, one per line.

subagents.desc: Manage vault-level Grok Build subagents from .grok/agent/ and legacy .grok/agents/. New entries are saved as subagent-only files and appear in the @mention menu.
subagents.title: Grok Build Subagents
subagents.noAgents: No Grok Build subagents in vault. Click + to create one.
subagents.nameDesc: Grok Build agent name. Use slash-separated segments for nested agents.
subagents.descriptionDesc: When Grok Build should use this subagent
subagents.stepsDesc: Maximum agentic iterations before forcing text-only output
subagents.hideFromMentionDesc: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu
subagents.disableAgentDesc: Disable the agent without deleting the file
subagents.promptDesc: Markdown body used as the agent prompt
subagents.promptPlaceholder: Review code changes carefully and call out correctness, regressions, and missing coverage.
subagents.invalidBooleanMap: {label} must map tool names to boolean values

environment.desc: Extra environment variables passed to Grok. `GROK_ENABLE_EXA=1` is enabled by default.
